question: Choose the best one-word substitute for "A person who writes dictionaries."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lexicographer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Lexicographer"** means a person who compiles or writes dictionaries. (शब्दकोश निर्माता)

 

 
• **Example:** Samuel Johnson was a famous lexicographer who compiled one of the first comprehensive English dictionaries.

 

 
• **"Lexicographer"** plays a crucial role in organizing and defining words systematically to make language more accessible and understandable. (शब्दकोश निर्माता)

 

 
• **Example:** Modern lexicographers use advanced software tools to create digital dictionaries.

 

 
• Hence, the word "Lexicographer" directly refers to the person who writes dictionaries.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Lexicographer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Novelist** (उपन्यासकार): A person who writes novels, which are fictional prose narratives.

 

 
• **Example:** Jane Austen, the famous novelist, is known for her works like "Pride and Prejudice" and "Emma."

 

 
• **Editor** (संपादक): A person who is responsible for preparing written content for publication by correcting, condensing, or modifying it.

 

 
• **Example:** The editor reviewed the manuscript and suggested several changes to improve the readability.

 

 
• **Proofreader** (प्रूफरीडर): A person who reads and corrects written material before it is published.

 

 
• **Example:** The proofreader carefully scanned the document for any spelling or grammatical errors.
